capabilities: focus the file explorer on a file or folder
hide all files and folders outside the focused branch
toggle focus via a command, right-click menu, or explorer button
configure focus level (file, parent, grandparent, great grandparent, custom folder)
extras: Part of the Vault CMS project; the README also promotes Zeku, a paid desktop writing app from the same developer. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Fork of the Simple Focus plugin plugin.
problem: Large vaults make the file explorer visually cluttered, and Obsidian offers no way to temporarily show only one branch of the folder tree.

relations.evidence: Fork of the Simple Focus plugin plugin.
Uses the virtual element patching approach (instead of DOM manipulation) inspired by File Explorer++.

summary: File explorer plugin that hides everything except a focused file or folder and its ancestors and children.
